title.en: R 5 2022 RELIGIOUS COUNCIL AND KADIS COURTS WAQAF OF MOSQUES SITES RULES

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-77-R-5-2022-RELIGIOUS-COUNCIL-AND-KADIS-COURTS-WAQAF-OF-MOSQUES-SITES-RULES.pdf》（9 页），本次切分 6 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Religious Council and Kadis Courts (Wakaf of Mosque Sites) Rules.
Any person who intends to dedicate his land for the purpose of a mosque site (in these Rules referred to as the person concerned) shall personally inform a Kadi of his

heading.en: Kadi to investigate and report to Majlis

text.en: The Kadi shall investigate the position and suitability of the land for such purpose, and shall make a report to the Majlis.

(1) The Majlis shall, after considering the report of the Kadi, and having carried out such further investigation as it considers necessary, determine whether or not the land is suitable for such purpose.

(2) If the Majlis considers that the land is suitable, the person concerned shall be required to make declaration in the form in the Schedule.

(3) Where the land is considered to be unsuitable, or for any other reasons it is considered that the intended dedication of the land is undesirable, the Majlis shall notify the person concerned, who may nevertheless, if he so insists, make a declaration in the form in the Schedule. 6 Religious Council and Kadis Courts

heading.en: Power of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan to validate declaration

text.en: A declaration made under rule 4 shall together with the recommendations, if any, of the Majlis be submitted to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, who may at his discretion sanction and validate the same in writing. Registration under Land Code (Chapter 40)

The Majlis shall cause to be registered in its name under the Land Code (Chapter 40) any land which is subject of the dedication so sanctioned and validated.
